dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three large, interconnected irregular ring-like shapes on the dorsal surface showing high-contrast, jagged borders and a transition from dark background to light-gray interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Sparsely distributed small, circular high-intensity light-gray clusters; two high-intensity orange-red clusters on the anterior tip.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three dominant dorsal rings form a triangle with the apex directed towards the dorsal-posterior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Linear reddish-orange cluster on the rostrum; narrow, horizontal pale marking on the mid-lateral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Complex dendritic/fractal internal patterning within the largest dorsal-lateral light-toned region.
